name: Togainu no Chi: Typing
source:
One of 3 preorder extras for Togainu no Chi. 

In TogaType, you play through select scenes of Togainu no Chi and must type the words to progress the game. Can be played from multiple points of view.
translation:
這是《咎狗之血》的3個預約特典之一。

在《TogaType》中，玩家需要體驗《咎狗之血》的指定場景，並輸入文字來推進劇情。遊戲可以從多個視角進行。
